_doc: Voice personas for free-voiceover (Kokoro, local). Settings resolve persona -> <project>/audio/voice.json -> command-line flags. voices: audition candidates, first is the default. wps: spoken words per second of line audio (a starting guess; voice.py measures the real value into audio/voice_timing.json and the lint uses it). Seconds: beat = one *(beat)* cue, inhale = pause before an *(inhale)* line, line_gap within a scene, scene_gap between scenes, lead_in before the first word, tail after the last. fx_chain: HyperFrames data-fx-chain nodes for the voiceover group, written by video-studio/scripts/audio_bed.py (the wav itself stays dry).

confessor.label: 4 A.M. Confessor
confessor.for: human-first faith and drama Shorts: tired, close, unpolished, never a narrator voice
confessor.paid_reference: a person whispering in a parked car at 4 a.m.

historian.label: Midnight Historian
historian.for: investigative lore, myth vs. truth, history and science essays: warm, calm, slightly wry

chronicler.label: Mythic Chronicler
chronicler.for: apocrypha sagas and royal tragedies: deep, solemn, monumental weight
chronicler.paid_reference: ElevenLabs: Adam, Antony or Marcus, stability 65%, style 15%

storybook.label: Warm Storybook Keeper
storybook.for: illustrated parables and nature allegories: gentle, unhurried, read beside a fire
storybook.paid_reference: a soft alto or tenor reading by a fireplace
